description.text: The fourth enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 19 March 2021, with new Single Strike and Rapid Strike cards: Galarian Slowking VMAX, whose attack Poisons for twelve damage counters, among the Single Strike cards, and Blaziken VMAX among the Rapid Strike cards. The Galarian forms of Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres appear as Pokémon V, with Dracozolt VMAX and the Supporters Karen's Conviction, Klara, Avery and Brawly. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Blaziken VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Snorlax, Fan of Waves, Urn of Vitality and Fighting Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Chilling Reign in June 2021 and Evolving Skies in August 2021.
